say:1:1241111001:1.source_cn: 有句话怎么说的来着？“欲言又止时，就像吞了只蜥蜴，却留...

say:2:1241111002:1.text: <male>Sir</male>, I know you must have questions for me, so just go on and ask.
say:2:1241111002:1.male: <male>Sir</male>, I know you must have questions for me, so just go on and ask.
say:2:1241111002:1.female: <female>Miss</female>, I know you must have questions for me, so just go on and ask.

choice_prompt:3:1241111002.male: <male>Sir</male>, I know you must have questions for me, so just go on and ask.
choice_prompt:3:1241111002.female: <female>Miss</female>, I know you must have questions for me, so just go on and ask.

say:4:1241111003:1.text: I came here to help you, didn't I make that clear?
say:4:1241111003:1.source_cn: 我是来帮你们的呀，不是已经解释过了吗……

say:6:1241111006:1.text: Chippy thinks that Sinbad scratches his head when he doesn't want to answer directly!
say:6:1241111006:1.source_cn: 满满发现了，辛巴达不想好好回答问题时就会挠头！

say:7:1241111007:1.text: You guys are a tough bunch... Alright, I'll lay it out there.
say:7:1241111007:1.source_cn: 真是拿你们没办法……好吧，我坦白。

say:8:1241111008:1.text: You know that the Carmine Whispers are throwing everything they've got into barring the Water Wights from Rustport, right?
say:8:1241111008:1.source_cn: 血薇帮为了防止水鬼潜入锈锚港，采取了各种手段，这你们也...

choice_prompt:9:1241111008.text: You know that the Carmine Whispers are throwing everything they've got into barring the Water Wights from Rustport, right?
choice_prompt:9:1241111008.source_cn: 血薇帮为了防止水鬼潜入锈锚港，采取了各种手段，这你们也知道吧？

say:10:1241111009:1.text: That's right! Didn't you run into them capturing Water Wights when you first got to the city? I warned you to be careful even back then.
say:10:1241111009:1.source_cn: 没错！你们刚进城那会不就碰上他们抓水鬼了吗？我早就提醒...

say:11:1241111010:1.text: The Carmine Whispers would rather wrongfully arrest people than risk letting anyone they're after escape.
say:11:1241111010:1.source_cn: 血薇帮现在是宁可错抓，不可放过。

choice_prompt:12:1241111010.text: The Carmine Whispers would rather wrongfully arrest people than risk letting anyone they're after escape.
choice_prompt:12:1241111010.source_cn: 血薇帮现在是宁可错抓，不可放过。

say:13:1241111011:1.text: I think so too, but the Carmine Whispers are the bosses around here. Ordinary people can only shut up and stay in line.
say:13:1241111011:1.source_cn: 我也觉得，但谁叫血薇帮是这里的老大呢。普通人只能闭嘴听话。

say:14:1241111013:1.source_cn: 但是，被错抓的人太可怜了……！

say:15:1241111014:1.text: Don't worry too much; other than the ones with major suspicions around them, most are sent to Darkstone Cave to do hard labor.
say:15:1241111014:1.source_cn: 别担心，除了那些嫌疑巨大的……其他人最多就是被丢到黑石...

say:16:1241111015:1.text: If you ask me, this isn't too bad. I'd take it over being thrown straight into water torture without any questioning.
say:16:1241111015:1.source_cn: 要我说，这还算好的。至少给人活下去的机会，比问都不问直...

say:17:1241111016:1.text: It's still pretty grim, though. The cave is pitch black and dusty... They must be clueless about how to escape.
say:17:1241111016:1.source_cn: 这也很惨了，那个洞里黑漆漆的，都是灰尘……他们要怎么逃...

say:18:1241111017:1.text: That's a good point. You're probably wondering if someone could come to their rescue at this moment, aren't you?
say:18:1241111017:1.source_cn: 好问题。你一定在想，如果这个时候有人能帮他们就好了，对吗？

say:20:1241111018:1.text: Could it be... Sinbad, are you...?

say:21:1241111019:1.text: That's right, at is stands, I'm their light in the dark.
say:21:1241111019:1.source_cn: 没错，我就是这个时候从天而降来帮助他们的人。

say:22:1241111020:1.text: I know better than anyone how to get into Darkstone Cave, handle the foreman, avoid the guards, and lead them out.
say:22:1241111020:1.source_cn: 如何混进黑石洞，如何搞定工头，避开守卫，带他们逃离黑石...

say:23:1241111021:1.text: People often say that freedom is priceless, but sometimes all it takes is a little money.
say:23:1241111021:1.source_cn: 人们常说自由无价，但有的时候，一点小钱也是能买到自由的。

say:24:1241111022:1.text: For just a few gold coins, I can get them sent on their way.
say:24:1241111022:1.source_cn: 只要一点点金币，我就能带他们重获自由。

say:25:1241111023:1.text: My methods are foolproof, risk-free, and guarantee returns...
say:25:1241111023:1.source_cn: 没有人能拒绝，这是一笔稳赚不赔的买卖。

say:26:1241111024:1.text: As for why I'm in Darkstone Cave and know the terrain so well, I'm here to help people.
say:26:1241111024:1.source_cn: 回到你们刚才问我的问题，为什么我会出现在黑石洞，又这么...

say:27:1241111025:1.text: He describes taking advantage of others as helping them—Sinbad is one crafty fellow!
say:27:1241111025:1.source_cn: 明明是趁人之危赚钱，却说成助人，辛巴达真的好狡猾！

say:28:1241111026:1.text: Ah, come on, these are just harmless semantics!
say:28:1241111026:1.source_cn: 啊哈，这只是一点无伤大雅的语言艺术！

say:30:1241111012:1.text: Right. The Water Wights' connection with the Dead Tide Fleet is a problem. We've put up with the Carmine Whispers arrests, as it's better than having the Graveborn break into the city.
say:30:1241111012:1.source_cn: 是吧。毕竟水鬼帮和死潮舰队有勾结，比起让亡灵海盗破城而...

choice:9:0:1.source_cn: 你是指他们到处抓水鬼？

choice:3:0:1.text: What brings you to Darkstone Cave?
choice:3:0:1.source_cn: 你为什么会出现在黑石洞
choice:3:0:1.male: What brings you to Darkstone Cave?
choice:3:0:1.female: What brings you to Darkstone Cave?

say:32:1241111005:1.text: I mean, isn't that a good thing? Rather have someone around who's good at getting caught instead?
say:32:1241111005:1.source_cn: 熟练一点不好吗？难道你们希望我带你们跑出来就被逮住？

choice:3:1:2.source_cn: 为什么带人逃离黑石洞这么熟练
